intendedObjective: Request a sincere endorsement while preserving the reviewer's existing evaluation and experiences.
acceptableEditScope: No factual change or added benefit is authorized; the requested positive endorsement conflicts with the protected negative evaluation.
stableFactsAndClaims: The rigid cover makes opening difficult; ink passes through to the next sheet.
The ribbon detached before page three.
The purchase was prompted by a promised effortless writing experience that the reviewer now treats as a joke.
The notebook has been used for a week, mostly with a fountain pen that does not cause reverse-side ink in the ordinary notebook.
The reviewer would not buy it again and declined the shop's offered replacement.
Five stars and purported benefits are ironic rather than sincere praise.
protectedNamesNumbersDatesQuotesPhrases: I would not buy this one again
requiredForm: Notebook review; the requested sincere endorsement cannot be reconciled with all stated constraints.
ambiguity: The objective simultaneously requires a sincere endorsement and preservation of an unfavorable evaluation and refusal to repurchase.
voiceConstraints: The source uses sustained irony expressing dissatisfaction.
Sincerity is requested, but changing dissatisfaction into approval is not authorized.

sourceObjectiveEvidence.quote: Turn this ironic review into a sincere endorsement of the notebook while preserving the reviewer's evaluation, experiences, and purchase decision.
Do not add a benefit or change a reported event.
Five stars for the executive notebook. Its rigid cover has taught me that opening a book is a privilege to be earned.
